items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I was staying with Harold then.

ctx.x: He would go through the challenges with you and...

He would go through it with you and, like, you always feel, if this guy don't find it, can't find the holes in it, there's no holes in it. Because he leans that way with his ideas and thoughts anyhow. And he's a bright man, a very bright man. A funny man, but he's a very bright man.

And I was saying to him, 'You know, I just finished this thing I have;' I finished it out, copied it out and I was so proud of it, I was carrying it around with me. I had it in my little briefcase. And I had gone to Los Angeles and I took it down there with me. Not just for Bill, but just I had it, because I had...You know how you have some special people you like to say, 'Hey, just take a look at this and see what you think.'
